snapcast_stream_sample_rate.label: Snapcast stream sample rate
snapcast_stream_sample_rate.description: Only used with an external Snapserver. Sample rate Music Assistant sends into Snapcast (48000, 96000, or 192000). Your Snapcast clients must support the chosen rate. Default is 48000.

snapcast_stream_bit_depth.label: Snapcast stream bit depth
snapcast_stream_bit_depth.description: Only used with an external Snapserver. Bit depth Music Assistant sends into Snapcast (16 or 24). 24-bit needs an external Snapserver built with packed 24-bit PCM support; the built-in Snapserver and normal package builds do not support this yet. Default is 16.

manifest.description: Synchronize and play music across Snapcast clients (including web browsers and Android devices) on your network.
